name: Battle Standard
effect: All Astartes within 1km who share a [CHAPTER] Keyword with the banner receive +2 dice to Resolve Tests and Conviction Tests.
note: No Value, Rarity or Keywords printed.

name: Halo Indomitus
effect: This functions as an AR 3 Invulnerable force field and gives +1 to all Leadership (Wil) and Intimidation (Wil) Tests against creatures with the ADEPTUS ASTARTES Keyword.
note: No Value, Rarity or Keywords printed. Armour block from the Effect's "AR 3 Invulnerable force field".

name: Molecular Bonding Studs
effect: Power armour fitted with Molecular Bonding Studs can equip additional armour plates. These grant +2 AR but are destroyed if the wearer is struck by a weapon with an AP better than -3. This is done after the attack has been resolved. Shattered plates can be replaced by a suitable skilled Tech-Priest or, more typically, a Chapter's Techmarine.
note: No Value, Rarity or Keywords printed.

name: Narthecium
effect: Adds +1 dice to all Medicae (Int) Tests and a further +2 dice to Tests to surgically recover progenoid glands. Refills a Sanguine Flask in one round.
note: No Value, Rarity or Keywords printed. The text says it can be used as a close-combat weapon, but no weapon profile is printed.

name: Omni-Scrambler
effect: Adds +3 bonus dice to any Tech (Int) or Intimidate (Wil) Tests to disrupt enemy communications within 500 metres.
note: No Value, Rarity or Keywords printed. "Intimidate (Wil)" as printed (the Skill is Intimidation).

name: Sanguine Flask
effect: Consuming the contents of a Sanguine Flask allows an Astartes to recover 1d3 Shock and staves off the Red Thirst for 24 hours.
note: No Value, Rarity or Keywords printed.

name: Teleport Homer
effect: A Teleport Homer provides a stable targeting focus for a teleportation chamber to lock onto, allowing for the safe teleportation of troops to its location.
note: No Value, Rarity or Keywords printed, and no Effect line; effect is the entry's one rules sentence.
